QuestInfo.name: Kid Sibling Wanted
QuestInfo.0: Tae Soo had a wish. What could it be?
QuestInfo.1: Tae Soo wants a cute and nice sibling. He believes that storks bring babies so he wants to ask a stork for a favor in bringing him a sibling. This whole business doesn't sound right to you but you decide to go see the #bstork#k anyway.
QuestInfo.2: You ask the stork to bring Tae Soo a younger sibling but you knew it was going to fail from the start.  You instead give Tae Soon a panda you captured and tied up with the rope that you got from the stork. The Panda doesn't look so cut but Tae Soo is happy regardless.
